verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers the CLI, the MCP server, agent skills and llms.txt. None of it mentions API versioning or a documented deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
